result.keyword: Which no win no fee compensation lawyers in Brisbane would you recommend?
result.markdown:
Yes. I searched current Brisbane options, focusing on firms that explicitly offer **no-win-no-fee personal-injury/compensation work**, rather than just general law firms.

### My Brisbane shortlist

**1. WT Law - Car Accident Lawyers Brisbane — my first choice for a strong, established personal-injury practice**

WT Compensation Lawyers specifically handles personal-injury matters and says it operates on a no-win-no-fee basis, including TPD claims. Its Brisbane office currently has a **5.0/5 rating from 120 reviews** in the local-business results I checked. [wtlaw.com.au](https://wtlaw.com.au/personal-injuries-qld/lawyers-brisbane/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[WT Compensation Lawyers](https://wtlaw.com.au/personal-injuries-qld/lawyers-brisbane/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**2. The Personal Injury Lawyers Brisbane — worth comparing**

A specialist personal-injury practice with a **5.0/5 rating from 145 reviews** in the current Brisbane business results. I'd include them in your first round of consultations, particularly if your claim is a motor-vehicle, workplace or public-liability matter.

**3. Ascent Lawyers — particularly attractive on fee transparency**

Ascent is interesting because it specialises exclusively in personal injury and currently reports **4.9/5 from 292 Google reviews**. It says there are no upfront costs, it covers medical/expert disbursements while the claim runs, charges no uplift fee, and if the claim fails it doesn't charge its professional fees or those covered disbursements. [www.ascentlawyers.com.au](https://www.ascentlawyers.com.au/no-win-no-fee?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Ascent Lawyers — No Win No Fee](https://www.ascentlawyers.com.au/no-win-no-fee?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**4. Splatt Lawyers — particularly worth considering if specialist credentials matter**

Splatt is Brisbane-based and led by Kerry Splatt, who is a **Queensland Accredited Specialist in Personal Injury Law**. The firm says approved matters are handled on a 100% no-win-no-fee basis, with no upfront professional fees and no professional fees if the claim is unsuccessful, subject to the costs agreement. [splattlawyers.com.au](https://splattlawyers.com.au/personal-injury/legal-fees/no-win-no-fee/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ascentlawyers.com.au](https://www.ascentlawyers.com.au/no-win-no-fee?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Splatt Lawyers — No Win No Fee](https://splattlawyers.com.au/personal-injury/legal-fees/no-win-no-fee/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**5. Shine Lawyers Brisbane — established larger-firm option**

Shine is considerably larger and has a **4.5/5 rating from 195 reviews** in the current business results. I'd consider them if you prefer a big national practice and want to compare their proposed costs with smaller specialist firms.

### If it were my claim

I'd **speak to 3 firms before signing anything**:

1. **WT Law**
2. **Ascent Lawyers**
3. **Splatt Lawyers**

The important point is that **"no win, no fee" doesn't mean the same thing at every firm**. You want the solicitor to explain, in writing:

- exactly what happens if you lose;
- whether you pay disbursements/expert reports if you lose;
- their professional fees if you win;
- whether there's an **uplift/success fee**;
- whether there are any circumstances where you're personally liable for costs;
- what you will actually receive **after all legal costs, Medicare/WorkCover/Centrelink reimbursements and other deductions**.

For example, Ascent explicitly says it doesn't charge an uplift fee and covers certain disbursements, while Splatt advertises no uplift fees and capped legal fees. [splattlawyers.com.au](https://splattlawyers.com.au/personal-injury/legal-fees/no-win-no-fee/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ascentlawyers.com.au](https://www.ascentlawyers.com.au/no-win-no-fee?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**One important caveat:** this is a shortlist based on publicly available information and current reviews, not a guarantee that one firm will achieve a better settlement than another. Your particular type of claim can make a big difference.

If you tell me **what sort of compensation claim you have** (car accident/CTP, workplace injury, public liability, medical negligence, TPD, etc.), I can narrow this down to **the 3 Brisbane lawyers I'd choose for that specific type of case**, including their fee arrangements and reviews.
